item.title: Greene County deputies rescue newborn and mother after standoff
item.description: Cody Deckard was taken into custody and charged with multiple counts of domestic assault, endangering the welfare of a child, and armed criminal action after preventing four individuals from leaving a residence and fleeing from deputies.

item.title: A few days to thaw ahead of next arctic attack
item.description: The Ozarks are still experiencing snow and cold, with black ice expected to form on roads and parking lots, patchy fog possible, and another arctic front bringing sub-freezing temperatures this weekend.
